mdna_quote: Actual expenditures ended the year approximately $2.7 million under budget. The most notable is the group insurance appropriation, which ended the year $1.4 million under budget.

Mid-year de-appropriation of $1,106,382 reduced original $14.47M budget to $13.37M final; actual landed within $359K of revised. First year in 12 to break the 12-22% structural pad pattern. FY25 MD&A general fund section says revenues and expenditures approximated each other, dropping the prior years standard insurance surplus language.
